content.short: Rugdog is a smart contract auditor.
content.description: Rugdog is dedicated to strengthening security for both new and established projects by rigorously testing and reviewing smart contracts to identify bugs and potential issues. Their approach emphasizes thorough checks that help teams reduce risk and improve code quality throughout development and deployment. Rugdog supports a wide range of blockchains and smart contract languages, enabling consistent security practices across diverse ecosystems. This multi‑chain coverage supports work across major development environments, helping teams build trust with users and investors.
